ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a fused bicyclic structure, with a benzene ring on the left and a six-membered ring on the right; an upper carbonyl C=O is connected above, and an OSO2NH4 substituent is connected below; on the right there is also a curved arrow from the carbonyl toward :NH3, which is ignored according to the question. Then reason: Count non-hydrogen bonds by structural blocks. 1) The benzene ring on the left has 6 C–C ring-forming bonds. 2) The six-membered ring on the right shares one edge with the benzene ring, so it adds only 5 more C–C bonds, and the skeleton totals 11. 3) Add another 1 for the upper carbonyl C=O, making 12. 4) Add another 1 for the lower C–O bond connected to oxygen, making 13. 5) Count another 4 bonds inside the substituent: 1 O–S, two S=O as 2, and 1 S–N, totaling 17. 6) Bonds related to hydrogen atoms and arrows are not counted. Therefore the total number of bonds is 17.

raw_record.question_text: In the transition-state structure shown in the image, calculate the total number of bonds in the structure, including single, double, and triple bonds but excluding those involving hydrogen. Disregard arrows and consider all components present in the transition-state structure.

method.method_draft: Inspect the image, then count by fragments. Count the fused carbon skeleton: benzene ring has 6 C–C ring bonds, and the attached six-membered ring contributes 5 additional C–C bonds because the fused C–C edge is already counted, giving 11. Add the carbonyl C=O bond at the upper right: +1. Add the ring-to-substituent C–O bond at the lower carbon: +1. Add bonds within the sulfate/ammonium substituent: O–S +1, two S=O bonds +2, and S–N +1. Ignore the curved arrow and the separate ammonia N–H bonds. Sum 11 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 1 = 17.

先描述图像：图中是一个稠合双环结构，左侧为苯环，右侧为一个六元环，上方连有一个羰基 C=O，下方连着一个 OSO2NH4 取代基；右侧还有一个从羰基指向 :NH3 的弯箭头，按题意忽略。
再推理：按结构分块统计非氢键。
1) 左侧苯环有 6 个 C–C 成环键。
2) 右侧六元环与苯环共用一条边，因此只再增加 5 个 C–C 键，骨架合计 11。
3) 上方羰基 C=O 再加 1，变为 12。
4) 下方与氧相连的 C–O 键再加 1，变为 13。
5) 取代基内部再计 4 个键：O–S 1 个、两个 S=O 2 个、S–N 1 个，合计 17。
6) 氢原子相关键以及箭头不计入。
因此总键数为 17。
